facts.fact: Tunisia's National Frequency Agency hosted in Tunis the ATU-coordinated Third African Preparatory Meeting for WRC-27, which opened on 2026-09-08 and ran to 11 September, according to the ATU.
Ms Sana Souai Lakhal of Tunisia's National Frequency Agency took over as chairperson of Africa's WRC-27 preparatory process from Kenya's Mohamed Haji at the Tunis meeting, according to the ATU.
